text:
timothy: Heads-up — planning a split rollforward for the API/SDK surface this Friday 23:00 PT (v2 -> v3 split). Main goals: zero-downtime for existing clients, preserve /v2 embeddings and streaming behavior, and a fast rollback path. Who can own smoke and rollback readiness?

maya: I can own infra smoke. I'll run the preflight suite against the canary pool and verify latency P95 and error budget. Need the exact canary bucket and the list of endpoints to hit.

aj: I'll draft client comms + changelog tonight. Quick ask: do we have any deliberate breaking changes for server-side-only fields? Need to call them out.

infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: Scheduled maintenance window recorded: 1719062400 (Fri 23:00 PT). Automated canary will run 10% traffic for 15m then shift. :calendar:

maya: Canary bucket is "canary-api-split-3". Smoke checklist (short):
```
- health /internal/health
- basic generate /v3/generate (short prompt)
- embeddings /v2/embeddings (regress)
- streaming websocket handshake
- auth + rate-limit sanity
```
I will post results to this thread.

sara: Rollback plan (high level):
1) pause canary -> route traffic back to v2 gateway
2) revert service deployment (k8s rollout undo)
3) flip feature flag in FF service to force v2 routing
4) escalate if errors > 1% or latency spike > 2x P95
I'll own the rollback steps and runbook during the window.

dan: I'll run the smoke runner from my laptop and tail logs. My script:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --env=staging --canary=canary-api-split-3 --tests=quick
```
Expect to post pass/fail and raw logs. Tagging @oncall for monitoring coverage.

oncall: I can cover 22:30-01:30 PT. I set alert thresholds and dashboard: latency P95, 5xx rate, KV cache miss ratio. If alerts fire, ping #incidents immediately.

aj: Client comms plan: short email + GitHub release notes + breaking-change callouts in SDK README (if any). ETA for drafts: EOD Wed. Also prepare migration snippet for users who pinned model endpoints.

alex.k: Quick compat note — we must keep old query param names supported for two releases. I added a tiny middleware shim in deploy branch to map old->new names, so we can toggle without client churn.

maya: One more ask — perf smoke: please run a 1-min regen at 20 tokens/req and 100 concurrent connections in the canary. That will exercise batching.

timothy: Sounds good. Owners:
- infra smoke: maya
- rollback runbook: sara
- smoke runner / logs: dan
- client comms: aj
- monitoring / alerts: oncall

timothy: Checklist before window (short):
- [ ] canary config validated (maya)
- [ ] rollback runbook posted (sara)
- [ ] comms draft ready (aj)
- [ ] ops oncall present (oncall)
- [ ] fluff: legal/regression signoff if needed

maya: I'll post a final ✅ in this thread at least 30m before the window with smoke outputs and baseline metrics.

dan: If anything goes sideways I'll post logs + short tl;dr. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder: don't forget to tag @support for client-facing inquiries during the first 24h post-rollout.

timothy: Thanks all — will follow up with a quick runbook link and the final timing. Keep updates here.
